verdict_reason: Smartsheet has a well-documented public REST API with an OpenAPI reference, guides, webhooks, and official SDKs in four languages, so the API itself is broad and buildable. However, access is gated by plan: "The Smartsheet API is restricted to users on Business and Enterprise plans" and the API introduction lists "Required plan: Business, Enterprise, or Advanced Work Management." Credentials are otherwise self-serve (UI-generated API tokens and OAuth app registration via Developer Tools), with no partner application or app review documented, so this is paid-plan gating rather than partner-only access.
main_blocker: Business/Enterprise (or Advanced Work Management) plan required for API access
open_questions: No documented sandbox/test environment was found in the evidence bundle; only a production server environment is referenced. Confirm whether Smartsheet offers a sandbox account for API testing.
Rate limits are explicitly stated to vary without notice; no concrete request-per-window figures are documented in the fetched pages (only example X-RateLimit-* headers).
The changelog and deprecation-process pages appeared in search results but their content was not fetched, so the exact versioning/deprecation policy is unverified.
Whether a free trial or lower-tier plan can obtain API tokens was not confirmed; the docs state Business/Enterprise (or Advanced Work Management) is required.
The API token page (help.smartsheet.com/articles/2482389-generate-API-key) was only available as a snippet; token generation flow details were not fully captured.

audit.auth_note: Page S9 explicitly documents access tokens/API keys and the Bearer header, and also describes OAuth 2.0 (3-legged) as the user-consent method; OAuth 2.0 is separately documented in S10.
audit.sandbox_note: sandbox_or_test_env=false is low confidence: no sandbox was found in the fetched sources, and the only environment language referenced is production.
